dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001223\_10](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001223) Category 1 during the period Oct 07 2025-Oct 09 2025 in Antigua and Barbuda, Montserrat, Guadeloupe, Dominica, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Anguilla, Martinique, Virgin Islands British. The center of the storm was located near latitude 17.3 longitude -60.6. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
